summary: Alico, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an Agricultural Lease Agreement with United States Sugar Corporation for approximately 3,280 acres in Hendry County, Florida. The initial term runs July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027, with a U.S. Sugar option to extend for ten years and an option to purchase at $29,520,000 (approx. $9,000/acre). This is an operational lease and purchase option, not a special-situation M&A, tender, restructuring, or activist event. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is specified. Watch for lease extension or option exercise; no arbitrage angle.
